title: Strengthen governed secondary use of health data
requirements:
- Qualify 'capture once, use many times' with purpose and minimisation
- Require provenance, coverage, denominator and timeliness assurance before data is treated as ground truth
- Consider raising SHRF-8 to Required for federated and virtual implementations
- Require separate environments, disclosure control and approval for analytics and surveillance
- Carry machine-readable policy metadata with reused data
